name: Bura Bura
source:
Takuji is a guy who’s pretty popular among the girls, but he already has someone he likes: Hitomi, his osananajimi who’s doting and is quite a cute… guy!? Their childhood friend Nakaba, as well as other girls, want him to snap him out of the trap and lead him back to ‘normality’.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/03/01/march-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
拓司很受女孩欢迎，但他已经有喜欢的人了：溺爱着他的青梅竹马瞳，一个相当可爱的……男生！？另一位青梅竹马半叶和其他女孩都想让他摆脱这位伪娘，回归“正常”。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/03/01/march-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
